annotation_method: Independent visual inspection of existing baseline page images and contact sheets; no detector, OCR, model, or network used.
coordinate_system: PDF points, x right, y down; bbox [left, top, right, bottom]; page numbers 1-based; row/column indices 0-based

evaluation_policy.count_rows: Logical semantic rows, including table headers; wrapped text, parenthesized ranges, and stacked numeric lines within one data record remain in one row.
evaluation_policy.bbox_policy: Approximate full-width grid region including horizontal table rules and header, ending after last data row; captions and footnotes excluded. Bboxes are visually estimated from original unannotated baseline renders and scaled to page points.
evaluation_policy.blank_header_spans: Blank leading header cells have no visible internal boundary. Treat vertical spanning versus separate blank cells as ambiguous; evaluate substantive grouped header spans separately.
evaluation_policy.content_policy: No paper contents are transcribed. Cell text and scientific or medical conclusions are outside this reference.

ambiguities: Leading blank label column may span the two header rows.
Count header is positioned in the lower header row with blank space above; a vertical span is an acceptable alternative representation.
Page is natively landscape with the table upright and a vertical running header at right; do not rotate the table grid by 90 degrees.
The long title wraps onto two lines above the grid and must not add rows.
There is no obvious bottom grid rule; end bbox after last body row, before the explanatory prose.
Leading blank label header may span both header rows.
The title above the grid wraps and must not be included as rows.
No strong bottom rule; footnotes begin below the final body record.

negative_pages.note: Metadata blocks and barcode do not constitute a paper table.
Numbered anatomical drawing is a figure, not a table.
Four vertically stacked labeled image panels are not table rows.

mixed_page_negative_regions.note: Panel arrangement is not a logical table grid.
